title: Nectar de mangue (Mango Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Ripe mangoes soaked 5 minutes in water with a little bleach, peeled, cut, pressed and filtered; the juice boiled 10 minutes with water and sugar, cooled and bottled in sterilised bottles.
longDesc: p. 77 of the October 2023 recipe book: 2 kg ripe mangoes, 1 kg sugar and 5 litres of water, with an optional preservative. The mangoes are soaked in drinking water containing ‘un peu de javel’ (a little bleach) for 5 minutes, peeled, cut, pressed and filtered; water and sugar are added and the mix boiled 10 minutes; cooled; the preservative added; bottled in sterilised bottles; kept cool. The page states the bleach soak removes microbes and the boil destroys them. The bleach and preservative quantities are not printed, and the diagram shows 70 °C for 5 minutes against 10 minutes of boiling in the text.
ingredients: A little bleach (javel) for the soak — quantity not printed
steps: Soak the mangoes in drinking water with a little bleach for 5 minutes. (Rinse as you would for any bleach-washed produce — the page prints no rinse step.)
Add the water and sugar. Boil 10 minutes.
Bottle in sterilised bottles. Keep cool.
chefTips: The page says the bleach soak removes microbes and the boil destroys them.
The bleach quantity is not printed — use food-safe produce-wash practice instead of guessing.
The diagram shows 70 °C for 5 minutes; the text says 10 minutes.
storage: Keep cool. No shelf life is printed.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar de mangue’ (p. 77). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 20 is a placeholder. TWO-PASS.

CONFLICT (unreconciled): ‘Cuisson (70°, 5min)’ in the diagram vs 10 minutes boil in the text. ABSENT: bleach and preservative quantities; rinse step; shelf life. SAFETY STATEMENT AS PRINTED: the bleach soak and the boil are meant to remove or destroy microbes. The rinse note in step 1 is an editorial caution, not the source’s.
